fieldUpdates.description: To have the first letter, letter after hyphen, and letter after space as caps
fieldUpdates.formula:
IF ( CONTAINS( FirstName , " "), ( UPPER(MID( FirstName , 1,1) ) & LOWER(MID(FirstName,2, FIND(" ", FirstName) -2)) & UPPER(MID (FirstName, FIND(" ", FirstName),2)) & LOWER(MID(FirstName, FIND(" ", FirstName) +2, 255 )) ),
IF ( CONTAINS( FirstName , "-"), ( UPPER(MID( FirstName , 1,1) ) & LOWER(MID(FirstName,2, FIND("-", FirstName) -2)) & UPPER(MID (FirstName, FIND("-", FirstName),2)) & LOWER(MID(FirstName, FIND("-", FirstName) +2, 255 )) ), IF ( CONTAINS( FirstName , "'"), ( UPPER(MID( FirstName , 1,1) ) & LOWER(MID(FirstName,2, FIND("'", FirstName) -2)) & UPPER(MID (FirstName, FIND("'", FirstName),2)) & LOWER(MID(FirstName, FIND("'", FirstName) +2, 255 )) ), UPPER(LEFT( FirstName,1))+LOWER(MID(FirstName,2,80)) ) ) )
fieldUpdates.name: Init caps first name
